text:
You need help managing case files, paperwork, and client follow-ups for a law firm, and I can support that with careful, organized admin work.  

I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in data analysis, Excel, Google Sheets, and dashboard work, and I’m comfortable with detailed file handling, data entry, and maintaining accurate records. I also bring strong Excel and documentation skills that translate well to organized case and file management.  

One project I built was a Dental clinic expansion model for Sunrise Dental Partners using Excel and financial modeling. I created a three-site expansion model with best, base, and worst cases for patient volume and staffing, and the chosen site was projected to pay back in 14 months.  

I’m detail-oriented, dependable, and ready to follow your training for each case type.
